# Quantum Water

> Quantum Water is a free 3D browser game that teaches Grover's quantum search through desalination pump scheduling. Everything quantum is simulated. It was created by Hassan Barmandah.

## Pages
- [Play the game](https://quantumwater.hsnb.site/): run a desalination plant and pick the cheapest pump times
- [Team and creator](https://quantumwater.hsnb.site/team.html): Hassan Barmandah, Vice President of the Research and Development Club at Umm Al-Qura University, and the characters of the game
- [Maths check](https://quantumwater.hsnb.site/maths.html): the cost table for all 32 plans

## Creator
Hassan Barmandah: ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0000-3518-3693 , GitHub https://github.com/HasanBGit
